title: Wojak got rug pulled by Terra Luna
description: Wojak was afraid of entering the market. He decided to not invest his money and watch the market sink. But Zoomer called him ...

asr.full_text: The Crypto The Crypto The Crypto The Crypto The Crypto Damn! Have you looked at the market bro? Everything is plunging. It's the biggest dump I have seen so far. All the crypto are deep red and losing over double digits. It's crazy. The market fear is at an all time high. This means that I'm not going to invest any funds for now because it's too dangerous. We need to be very careful and wait for the storm to be over guys. It's for safety reasons. What's up Zuma? What's going on? Dude, have you seen this market crash? It's fucking crazy. I can't believe it. Solana lost like 25% and Bitcoin 15%. So many people are losing money right now. But I have a strategy man, we are going to think smarter than the crowd. And what is your strategy? Everything is down so I don't understand how you could profit from that. Bro, it's really simple. We do not have to be mathematicians to make money. Here is what I did. I converted all my money into USST, the Terra Luna stablecoin. I started earning profits while staking them. I get up to 20% interest rate. I agree that's mad lat. I want to do the same bro. But is it safe to invest in stablecoins? I never tried before. Bro are you dumb? It's a stablecoin. It's literally written in the name. There is no need to do researches, since it's following the US dollar. It's why this strategy is so popular. You get money, while your investments are safe. Okay, bro. You did convince me. I'm going to do the same. I will put my last three thousand dollars into it and stake them. Terra luna to the moon and beyond. Exactly, bro! No one can stop us and the mad babies can kiss my middle finger real quick! See you! Bye! Have you heard this? I'm going to grab myself a huge bag of USD and stake them as soon as possible. Let's go on Pampit Swap. I'm going to swap for 3 grand. This is all the money I have. Let's be safe in this market, it's the best solution guys. Sometimes we need to accept that things are not going our way and for the zero risk option which is investing in stablecoin, like Zymer explained. There are no magic paths to wealth guys. It's a matter of risk management. Okay? Let's go take a walk. I need some fresh air right now. See you soon. Woooaaoow!!! No no no no no! Okay, let's refresh our portfolio and start to stake the tokens.

textual.observation: A speaker describes a strategy of converting money into a Terra Luna stablecoin and staking it, with a stated return of up to 20% interest and claims that the investment is safe.

evidence.quote: I converted all my money into USST, the Terra Luna stablecoin. I started earning profits while staking them. I get up to 20% interest rate.
There is no need to do researches, since it's following the US dollar. It's why this strategy is so popular. You get money, while your investments are safe.

textual.context: Dialogue between characters; whether the video is promoting the strategy or discussing it in a fictional/parody context is unclear from these records alone.
textual.potential_relevance: The cited return claim of "up to 20% interest rate" is linked to converting money into a named stablecoin and staking it, alongside safety claims about the investment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether any viewer is directly instructed to invest, whether the stablecoin or staking platform is actually available, or whether any outcome occurred.

textual.observation: A character says he will put his last three thousand dollars into the stablecoin strategy and stake it, then later says he will swap for 3 grand on Pampit Swap while describing stablecoin investing as a zero-risk option.

textual.context: Presented as character dialogue/narration during a market crash scenario; promotion versus cautionary demonstration is unclear without additional context.
textual.potential_relevance: A concrete money movement action, "swap for 3 grand," is tied to staking and a "zero risk option" claim about stablecoin investing.
textual.limitations: The source records do not verify the existence or destination of "Pampit Swap," do not show a completed transaction, and do not establish the speaker's intent.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents an animated cautionary story about a Terra Luna staking pitch rather than encouraging viewers to invest. The dialogue explicitly frames the market as dangerous, while the characters' claims that staking is safe, carries up to 20% interest, and is a zero-risk option are portrayed as reckless persuasion, followed by a distressed character and the title's reference to a rug pull.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: N01 fits because the video dramatizes and criticizes a deceptive-looking investment pitch. The apparent 20% staking claim and zero-risk assurance are presented as dialogue from a character whose decision leads into the rug-pull narrative, not as a creator-endorsed solicitation or instruction for the audience.
